source: Beginner short story written in spoken Israeli Hebrew by Claude. NOT native-validated.

sentences.en: In the morning I open the wardrobe.
I put on a white shirt and trousers.
In winter I need a coat as well.
My shoes are old but comfortable.

sentences.ar: אמא אומרת שאני צריך בגדים חדשים.
sentences.en: Mum says I need new clothes.
Maybe next week I'll buy some.
